kind: actual AIR cross-row SHA512 state chaining
formal_claims: Every nonfinal next state equals the current full round output.
Every decoded state equals iteration of actual rounds on prior decoded k/w inputs.
The terminal output equals iteration over the entire trace, including its final row.
Final-row state links vanish without cyclic wraparound.
limitations: k/w remain independent row inputs; changing final-row k or w still passes these constraints.
No message schedule, 80-round boundary, initial-state authentication, feed-forward, padding or digest binding.
Universal honest sequence trace completeness is not yet proved.
No full NEAR state-transition proof, 1 Pgas measurement, sub-300 KB proof or 128-bit quantum-security bound.
